connections_pending_expiry_ck.name: connections_pending_expiry_ck
connections_pending_expiry_ck.value: "connections"."state" NOT IN ('requested', 'invited') OR "connections"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

sessions_nonempty_half_open_range_ck.name: sessions_nonempty_half_open_range_ck
sessions_nonempty_half_open_range_ck.value: NOT isempty("sessions"."time_range") AND lower_inc("sessions"."time_range") AND NOT upper_inc("sessions"."time_range") AND NOT lower_inf("sessions"."time_range") AND NOT upper_inf("sessions"."time_range")

match_events_candidate_kind_ck.name: match_events_candidate_kind_ck
match_events_candidate_kind_ck.value: ("match_events"."candidate_type" = 'mentor' AND "match_events"."candidate_mentor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "match_events"."candidate_startup_id" IS NULL) OR ("match_events"."candidate_type" = 'startup' AND "match_events"."candidate_startup_id" IS NOT NULL AND "match_events"."candidate_mentor_id" IS NULL)

match_events_reason_ck.name: match_events_reason_ck
match_events_reason_ck.value: ("match_events"."event_type" = 'dismiss' AND ("match_events"."dismissal_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("match_events"."dismissal_reason") <= 500)) OR ("match_events"."event_type" <> 'dismiss' AND "match_events"."dismissal_reason" IS NULL)

match_events_connection_ck.name: match_events_connection_ck
match_events_connection_ck.value: ("match_events"."event_type" = 'request' AND "match_events"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("match_events"."event_type" <> 'request' AND "match_events"."connection_id" IS NULL)
